mentions.note: long time Belgravian, near 50 years' membership

photos.c: SUNDAY MORNING AT ARTHUR'S Some of the "gang" enjoying refreshments---and Ron Linstead's clowning---on the lawn of Lauriston Cottage. L. to R. (rear)Charlie Dabbs, Charlie Smart,Trevor Hart,Ron Mitchell,Arthur Bruce,Howard Satchell,Ron Linstead,Mel Thorpe,John Thresher. L. to R. (front)Peter Wrench,John Dear,Gordon Biscoe,Charlie Manning.

Left: The Paarlauf - a meeting of old friends. The Mitchell Brothers and Arthur Bruce are regulars. Frank Mitchell, left, coached Mitcham's international 800m runner Tony Harris while brother Ron, centre, will have been a Belgravian for 50 years in 1998. Arthur Bruce, right, needs no introduction.

Below: A Belgrave group at Tooting Bec track on 14 August 1949, with Stan Davies, sitting, second from the left. Left to right, back row: Alan Sexton, Len Adams, Tom Morrell, Archie Bedford, Johnny Morrison ?, --, --, --, Doug Briggs, --, --, George Isaacs. Front row: --, Stan Davies, J.Lacey ?, George Stace, Ron Mitchell. If anyone can confirm the names or fill in any of the blanks we'd most be pleased to hear from you.
